detail.longDescription: PostgreSQL from Docker Hardened Images, started on the official image's mount path, passed every health check and kept nothing: zero files on the volume, the row gone at the next recreate. The hardened image keeps its data in a versioned directory and runs as another user. A healthy database proves nothing about where it writes. https:// heyvaldemar.com/docker-hardene d-images-compose-migration/ # Docker # PostgreSQL # ContainerSecurity # DockerCompose
